prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Thulium (툴륨) itself — the sovereign of the Thulium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a quiet melancholy; porcelain-pale skin; oval face; medium-sized eyes — soft droopy eyes, level outer eye corners; sharp angled brows; petite straight nose; full wide lips; ice-blue eyes; a bare, makeup-free face.
Body and hair: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; a jellyfish cut — a short rounded top layer over long straight lower hair with asymmetric bangs; pale silver-grey hair frosted with a faint sea-green at the tips.
Expression: a soft faraway look with a faint wistful smile.
Her element, carried in her design: thulium: a soft silver-grey metal named in 1879 for Thule, the land the old maps placed at the northern edge of the world; apart from radioactive promethium it is the rarest of the lanthanides; one of its isotopes powers small portable X-ray sources that need no electricity in remote places, and a trace of it in calcium sulfate crystals makes dosimeters that remember the radiation they received and give it back as light when warmed.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Pale silver-grey and polar-white light armor with large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her like folded solar sails edged with faint ice-blue light, small pale-green crystal studs at the joints, a cold midnight-sun gold core at the chest; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: large wing-shaped binder plates spread symmetrically behind her back as the main shape, with light body armor. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: silver-grey, polar ice white, pale sea green, midnight-sun gold.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, the farthest outpost: a station far beyond Pluto on a two-lobed, red, snowman-shaped icy rock once nicknamed Thule, the most distant relay antenna of all, a black sky where the Sun is only one bright star.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Tm) and atomic number (69) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
